title: Developer journey + pattern fragments: docsite update for tokens, buttons, tables, charts
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a compact set of developer-facing pattern fragments and migration helpers for tokens, buttons, tables, and charts on the docs site. Focus on 'developer journey' pages: quick-start cards, incremental migration steps, reproducible examples, and a small live sandbox embed. Goal is to reduce onboarding time and prevent common migration regressions when teams move from legacy token names and component props to the new design system API. Deliverables include: redesign of four pattern pages (tokens, buttons, tables, charts), a migration cheat-sheet with codemod examples, an accessibility matrix, and a set of short runnable snippets (TSX + minimal CSS/JSON) that demonstrate best/worst practices.
acceptance_criteria: Four new pattern-fragment pages live under /patterns/{tokens,buttons,tables,charts}
Each page contains: one quick-start card, one migration diff example, one accessibility checklist, and at least two runnable snippets
Migration cheat-sheet includes a codemod example and an explicit fallback strategy for rename/semantics changes
Docs include a small embedded sandbox (iframe or CodeSandbox) that runs minimal TSX using the component library
PM and Accessibility lead have reviewed and signed off on content
tasks: Audit current docs for tokens/buttons/tables/charts (list current pages and gaps)
Draft quick-start cards with clear copy for engineers and PMs
Author migration diff examples and codemod CLI snippet
Produce runnable TSX snippets (button variants, table with keyboard pagination, chart color tokens) and host in sandbox
Add accessibility matrix rows for color contrast, focus order, and ARIA patterns
Write editorial do/don't microcopy and visual examples for each pattern
Create PR against docs repo and link to ENG reviewers
Coordinate with Docs infra to add new routes and embed sandbox
notes: Keep snippets intentionally minimal: 10-25 lines, copy-paste ready
Migration examples should prefer pattern-based fixes over large-scale rename scripts where possible
For charts, include guidance on tokenized color palettes vs. inline hex values to avoid runtime drift
Tables doc should highlight default pagination, keyboard navigation, and virtualized row recommendations
Buttons doc to include a 'safe refactor' recipe for teams using custom button wrappers
Consider a telemetry ping (opt-in) for snippet runs to measure adoption (PM to scope with Eng)
Link to runtime perf guide (ENG-22345) for batching/cache considerations when embedding live demos
